---
title: About Me
---

Hi! I'm Palmer Maurer, a recent graduate of Georgetown University with a B.S. in math. I began my academic journey at Georgetown as a chemistry major on the pre-med track, but over time I developed a stronger passion for math and stats. That shift ultimately shaped both my academic interests and my professional goals, as I am currently pursuing a career in actuarial science.

I'm from Princeton, NJ, and I'm a very dedicated New York Yankees fan, hence this project's theme. I love spending time with family and friends, and I'm grateful for the years with my family dog, Twix (a German shepherd and border collie mix). I also enjoy golfing, listening to rock music (e.g., the Eagles and Bruce Springsteen), and playing the cello, which I've done for many years, most recently as the principal cellist of the Georgetown University Orchestra.

Travel is another passion of mine, and Italy holds a special place in my heart. I've been very fortunate to visit several times with my family, and exploring every region remains on my bucket list.
